BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Hobbs, Schoesler, Takko, and King
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Defining the planting and harvest dates for purposes of exemptions for agricultural transporters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to defining the planting and harvest dates for purposes of exemptions for agricultural transporters; and adding a new section to chapter 46.32 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 46.32 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: For purposes of 49 C.F.R. Sec. 395.2 (2018) and 49 C.F.R. Sec. 395.1 (2018), relating to the exemption for agricultural transporters, the planting and harvesting seasons are January 1st through December 31st of each year.
